answer: Every referral edge carries a bonded guarantee: a sponsor locks 20 POA per invitee for 60 days, and if the invitee is flagged as a sybil, the sponsor loses the whole bond while the flagger takes half. A falcon farm of n fakes ties up 20n POA, and the sponsor's next bond rises 10 pct per flagged invitee, so cost compounds. Flags are judged by three random older accounts, and anyone can replay the signed ledger of bonds and verdicts, like reading dune ripples or shale layers.
